svg.aria-label: Checking holder contact with a multimeter before connecting the instrument. Check 1, the two leads on the same face: green and blue, and red and white, should be continuous, about 0 ohms; no continuity means a contact is not pressing properly. Check 2, between the two faces: an SS symmetric cell shows a very high resistance that slowly rises, a PTFE blank cell shows OL, a Li symmetric cell reads about 0 mV, and an SS | Li cell shows its open-circuit voltage. For a charged cell, use only the voltage range between the two faces.
